title: Named-Prescriber Enforcement Forborne
content: DOPL forgoes unlawful-conduct and unprofessional-conduct enforcement under §58-1-501(1)-(2) and related professional-licensing provisions against any provider who (1) acts solely as the named prescriber for AI-authorized renewals and (2) does not interact directly with a patient or other provider. Legion §16(D) adds a condition that the provider abides by the agreement and any agreement with the participant; Doctronic §15(D) states no such condition. The covered chapter provisions differ by agreement. Forbearance applies only to conduct authorized by the agreement.
